title: Scopes, casts, accessors, query builder vs raw

preview.what: Scopes, casts, accessors/mutators, and when to drop to the query builder or raw SQL.
preview.picture: Scopes are saved filters on a spreadsheet; casts translate the DB's language (JSON, dates) to PHP's; accessors are a display formatter on read.
preview.why: Knowing when Eloquent hurts performance is a senior signal.
preview.bn: Scope = সেভ করা filter, cast = DB-র ভাষা PHP-তে অনুবাদ, accessor = পড়ার সময় সাজানো; কখন raw SQL।
